e54c0f4d-e4b4-485c-b137-3879462d3b11.text_lemmatized: Mitosis is a process where a single cell divides into two identical daughter cells through cell division.

0efee90e-84fd-4b7f-b32f-d7dbfca7c659.data: Mitosis has five phases: Interphase, Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, and Telophase.
0efee90e-84fd-4b7f-b32f-d7dbfca7c659.text_lemmatized: Mitosis has five phases: Interphase, Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, and Telophase.

5b57398e-e398-4913-afd4-fe2159d056e2.data: During Interphase, the DNA in the cell is copied in preparation for cell division, resulting in two identical complete sets of chromosomes.
5b57398e-e398-4913-afd4-fe2159d056e2.text_lemmatized: During Interphase, the DNA in the cell is copied in preparation for cell division, resulting in two identical complete sets of chromosomes.

b53883d0-8001-4ba5-bea0-6683c4a66112.data: In Prophase, chromosomes condense into X-shaped structures that can be easily seen under a microscope, with each chromosome composed of two sister chromatids containing identical genetic information.
b53883d0-8001-4ba5-bea0-6683c4a66112.text_lemmatized: In Prophase, chromosomes condense into X-shaped structures that can be easily seen under a microscope, with each chromosome composed of two sister chromatids containing identical genetic information.

a8bd21e3-7639-4f6e-9f67-6b691d1b50bc.data: During Metaphase, chromosomes line up neatly end-to-end along the center (equator) of the cell, with the mitotic spindle fibers attaching to each of the sister chromatids.
a8bd21e3-7639-4f6e-9f67-6b691d1b50bc.text_lemmatized: During Metaphase, chromosomes line up neatly end-to-end along the center (equator) of the cell, with the mitotic spindle fibers attaching to each of the sister chromatids.

8fe475b2-49d7-48fc-a40c-41c5c90cb983.data: In Anaphase, the sister chromatids are pulled apart by the mitotic spindle, with one chromatid being pulled to one pole and the other chromatid to the opposite pole.
8fe475b2-49d7-48fc-a40c-41c5c90cb983.text_lemmatized: In Anaphase, the sister chromatids are pulled apart by the mitotic spindle, with one chromatid being pulled to one pole and the other chromatid to the opposite pole.

197e5dff-7f86-454c-9065-3e5744d46227.data: During Telophase, a full set of chromosomes gather together at each pole of the cell, with a membrane forming around each set of chromosomes to create two new nuclei.
197e5dff-7f86-454c-9065-3e5744d46227.text_lemmatized: During Telophase, a full set of chromosomes gather together at each pole of the cell, with a membrane forming around each set of chromosomes to create two new nuclei.
